page.content:
Classmate who said she saw Adnan in the library at the time of the crime.

How Asia McClain connects

  • Work: Serial Season 1 — Asia McClain is the classmate whose library alibi Season 1 examines.
  • Character: Adnan Syed — Asia McClain's account was offered as an alibi for Adnan Syed.

What is Asia McClain?

Asia McClain is the Woodlawn classmate whose letters claimed an alibi at the library, later a central figure in Adnan's appeals and in Serial's argument that the defense missed a witness.

Key threads lead to Serial Season 1 and Adnan Syed.
